help: Write down the price of a food in a shop. The application uses it to estimate the budget of a shopping plan and the cost of a recipe for each serving. A food has one price for each shop.
empty: No price yet. Add the price of the foods that you buy often: each shopping plan will show its budget.
store-hint: Choose a shop or type another name, for example "market".
price-invalid: The price must be more than zero.
regular-price-hint: Only if the price above is a promotion.
regular-invalid: The regular price cannot be lower than the price.
size-help: Without a content, the cost cannot be computed from a weight or a volume.
size-incomplete: Give the content and its unit, or neither.
by-weight-help: The shop sells any quantity at this rate: the cost is not rounded up to a whole pack.
label: Label
label-hint: For example: spaghetti no. 5, 500 g pack
promotion-over: The promotion is over: the regular price is used

source.title: Prices read from the shops
source.disabled: The automatic reading of prices is not enabled on this server. The prices typed by hand are enough for the budget.
source.help: Search a product at Coop, Migros, Aldi or Lidl, then keep its price for a food. Only the search text and the shops go to the price service. The shops name their products in German: "Milch", "Butter" or "Kürbis" find more offers than the English word.
source.unavailable: The price service does not answer. Your stored prices stay usable.
source.keep-title: Keep the price for a food
source.refresh: Refresh the prices read from the shops
source.refresh-none: No automatically read price to refresh.

budget.title: Estimated budget
budget.help: The price of the whole shopping in each shop, from the stored prices and rounded up to whole packs. It is an estimate, not a receipt.
budget.empty: No stored price for the items of this plan.
budget.recommended: The cheapest for the whole shopping
budget.covered: {priced} item of {total} has a price | {priced} items of {total} have a price
budget.estimated: {count} other estimated at {amount} | the {count} others estimated at {amount}
budget.not-comparable: Too few prices in this shop to compare it
budget.unpriced: {count} item has no price in any shop: it is counted nowhere. | {count} items have no price in any shop: they are counted nowhere.
budget.used: of which {amount} used by your recipes
budget.match: Search the products in the shops

reason.NO_FOOD: Free text: no food to price
reason.UNIT_MISMATCH: The unit does not fit the stored price

match.title: Products in the shops
match.help: For each item, the application searches the product that fits at Coop, Migros, Aldi and Lidl. Check the choices, then keep the prices: the budget then compares the whole shopping in each shop. Only the name of the food goes to the price service.
match.warning: A proposed product is not verified for your dietary restrictions. Always read the label.
match.unavailable: The price service does not answer. Try again later.
match.nothing: Nothing to search: each item already has a price in each shop.
match.query-hint: The shops name their products in German.

reason.TOO_MANY: Too many items at once: keep these prices, then search again
